method: Second intensive review: full-source control/data-flow tracing, exact-hash provenance comparison, cleave facts including text/literals/flow/archives/errors, atomscan before/after. Samples were never executed.
provenance_record: testdata/bluehammer-4051/review.json; evidence.json reconstructs these exact hashes as detection fixtures, not original FunnyApp.exe

samples.marker: PowerShell loader: screenshots, AV exclusion, payload; fixed traits
behavior: Creates a randomized TEMP work tree and adds it to Defender exclusions when already Administrator. This occurs before the country exit gate. No UAC bypass or privilege elevation is implemented.

Uses local RegionInfo as a fallback and tries three remote geolocation services, exiting for a configured 11-country set. Remote country responses may be malformed; the first API can provide the requested country_code.

Contacts start/end PHP URLs with computer name and country. Each response is piped to Out-Null before assignment, leaving startScript/endScript null; the conditional ScriptBlock execution paths are therefore not an established remote-code-execution chain.

Downloads an archive and 7za executable, invokes the latter with a password, derives an executable path under extraction output and launches it. The undefined process.ExitCode check may throw; its catch does not prevent the later launch path.

Captures VirtualScreen via CopyFromScreen twice, saves PNG to a MemoryStream, Base64-encodes the image, places the same value into a form body and posts it to the remote screen endpoint with the computer name.

Presents staged update progress and an unconditional fake missing-DLL error after the launch attempt. Clears current PSReadLine history, then waits for Enter before deleting the saved history file and setting SaveNothing. Does not delete its working directory after the payload launch.
samples.verdict_evidence: Unrequested desktop transmission, AV-excluded passworded payload launch, misleading updater/error UI and multi-layer command-history erasure collectively establish malicious purpose despite unknown payload identity.
samples.obfuscation: No concealed script stage or encoded executable is present. Base64 transports captured PNGs; ANSI control characters render progress. No hidden decoded payload or archive member was recovered.

samples.identification: BlueHammer stages 5-7 Python ctypes research fixture
samples.marker: BlueHammer Python fixture: research excerpt; added file-open trait
behavior: Defines update_race without an entry point/caller. Python module load performs only ctypes imports and function definition. C++ declares native functions and defines the routine; it is not a standalone executable.

Composes a Defender ncalrpc binding but never invokes procedure 42. Requests a batch oplock, waits for break, closes an old alias, creates NT object-manager aliases naming WDUpdateDirectory and mpasbase.vdm with a VSS SAM target, then releases the staged handle.

Opens the staged file transactionally, treats the handle as an offline registry hive, opens the SAM user key and reads its V record. Calls SamiChangePasswordUser for admin with caller-supplied old/new hashes. The record is not used to derive those hashes.

Worker state, transactions and prerequisites are harness inputs. No CloudFilter freeze, VSS creation/discovery, full privileged file-read acquisition chain, bootkey/hash decryption, service creation, SYSTEM shell, LSASS access, persistence or exfiltration is implemented.
samples.verdict_evidence: Exact hashes match documented generated research reconstructions. Partial, uncalled harness packaging corroborates that provenance; it does not erase the accurate exploit/credential-pattern findings.
samples.obfuscation: No encoded stage. Python raw Windows paths and C++ escaped wide strings are ordinary native API representations, not obfuscation.
samples.classifier_disagreement: The model continues to flag the known BENIGN research fixture. Retain accurate hostile detections rather than adding a name/provenance suppressor.

rule_changes: Add a hostile co-occurrence rule for excluded archive payload launch plus PSReadLine file deletion, disabled recording and in-memory history clearing. Existing suspicious deletion finding is retained. Precision 8.4; moved payload composite precision 7.9.

Geolocation references, uppercase pair arrays and a country-named membership test alone did not establish a hostile action or even an exit. A regional mirror/router can satisfy the old required evidence. Preserve arrays and membership as neutral observations; require an exit in that country branch and classify the gate suspicious. The attack consumer retains its reference.

Relocate eight firing observations/composites by actual claim. ErrorActionPreference is error handling, history location is a path query, PSReadLine recording mode is console control, inline image URI is a scheme, documentation hostname is a host, and excluded file execution is a payload sink rather than C2. Two additional misplaced token/serialized-command atoms were relocated with consumers intact after reviewing full 100-rule target leaves.
Add missed PowerShell Administrator-role and PSConsoleReadLine ClearHistory syntax observations. No elevation is claimed: the non-admin branch is empty.

Add Python CreateFileTransacted call coverage in a disjoint matcher, preserving the native symbol matcher and scope. Admit Windows source/binary groups and Python for the BaseNamedObjects namespace reference. Both are notable neutral observations.

intentional_severity_change.evidence: Regional routing and license/distribution restrictions can legitimately use geolocation. Country membership alone did not imply an exit or abuse. The sample still matches the tightened exit-gate rule.

verification.prior_positive_coverage: Both BlueHammer attack mechanisms retained on both exact originals; packed-referrer cloaking and stored JSON tool attack patterns retained; 16 independent prior BlueHammer near misses checked.
verification.model_limitation: Installed feature spec v18 versus extractor v21 warning. Calibrated grid level and raw probability are recorded separately from static trait severity.
verification.final_gate: make validate, run as the final action after writing markers
verification.final_atomscan_tiny: All three render scan hostile: update.ps1 confidence 0.990 FP L25; Python confidence 0.997 FP L0; C++ confidence 0.997 FP L1. These scanner classifications are not artifact verdicts.
verification.classifier_disagreements: Scanner remains HOSTILE for both BENIGN BlueHammer fixtures. The PowerShell MALICIOUS verdict agrees with the scanner. Probabilities changed as recorded, but calibrated levels stayed 25/0/1. Do not suppress accurate exploit signatures to force benign classifier agreement.
verification.validation_retry: Initial final-gate run found three stored JSON fixture expectations still using the moved atomic ID. Updated testdata/expectations.toml to the canonical metadata ID; positive and negative fixture behavior is unchanged.

limitations: No registry package identity, version, deployment authorization or execution history is supplied for update.ps1. No final executable payload bytes are embedded or obtained. Static script operations independently establish its malicious purpose.

No deployment or external harness is supplied for the race excerpts. Known exact-hash research provenance tips their artifact verdict to BENIGN, while exploit behaviors remain hostile findings. A caller integrating these routines into an unauthorized exploit would change the deployment assessment.

An existing, unchanged geogated WebClient consumer misses the independent control because this engine projects New-Object arguments as arrays while its atom expects a string. This pre-existing engine/matcher gap is recorded in consumers-before.json; no accurate finding on the supplied samples was removed.
